item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Upper-air disturbances will bring a few showers and thunderstorms to the region. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas near Luzon. An area of low pressure may also form over the trough of low pressure. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move across the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands and intensify gradually over the weekend. It will then edge closer to the coast of eastern China.
